name: floating-ui
title: Floating UI
responsibility: Positioning + interaction mechanics for floating elements — anchoring, collision-aware placement, hover/focus/click/dismiss behavior. Pure infrastructure.
reachFor: Tooltips, popovers, dropdowns, context menus, floating toolbars
Anchored panels that must track a moving/resting reference (autoUpdate)
Anything that must never clip off-viewport (flip/shift middleware)
avoid: Radix-covered primitives — shadcn Dialog/Tooltip/Popover already wrap Radix; reach for Floating UI when building *custom* floating patterns
Static positioned badges/chips — CSS `absolute` is enough, no engine needed
Dragging floating elements — that is GSAP Draggable territory
middlewareOrder: offset → flip/autoPlacement → shift → size → arrow → hide

canonicalStacks.popover: [offset(6), flip(), shift({ padding: 8 })] + useClick + useDismiss + useRole('dialog'|'menu') + whileElementsMounted: autoUpdate
canonicalStacks.hoverToolbar: [offset(10), shift({ padding: 8 })] + useHover({ move: false }) (+ useFocus) + useRole('toolbar'|'tooltip') + whileElementsMounted: autoUpdate

inRepo: 13 presets already build on it (floating-row-actions, floating-notif-dock, floating-chart-legend, floating-glossary, …)
